description: Method A: a global pairwise alignment by Biopython's PairwiseAligner. Every alignment of optimal score is enumerated; the representative is the 3'-most of them.
name: channelscope.m01.align_a

parameters.representative: 3'-most: the latest first gap column, then the latest second, and so on

description: Method B: a global pairwise alignment by parasail's nw_trace, a separately written C library. It scores in integers, so BLOSUM62 and both gap scores are doubled: the same scoring scaled by two, with its score in those units. One optimal alignment, by parasail's own tie-breaking.
name: channelscope.m01.align_b

parameters.substitution_matrix: BLOSUM62 x 2, parasail's own, checked equal to Biopython's on the 400 pairs of standard amino acids

description: Run methods A and B on two numberings, and build the per-column residue mapping from method A's representative alignment: identity in a window, the indel and ambiguity flags, and reliability by the mission's rules.

description: CL-3's gate cases: for each of S13's 26 entries, the case (a to d) of its gate residue's numbering under the rule CL-2's criteria fix (version 2.2, under 'The gate residue, and what CL-3 does with it', committed in 125f89f before CL-2's fetch and run), derived from CL-2's entries and segments tables by this script's own code. (a) checked against SIFTS: the gate residue joined, agree, at offset 0, an isoleucine, not identity low; (b) checked by this project's alignment alone: no SIFTS position for the chain, the gate residue joined, path A only, at offset 0, inside a run of offset 0 holding at least 10 modelled residues on each side; (c) anything else; an entry takes its worst chain's case; (d) CL-2's run stopped or unusable, or no analysed RyR1 chain. How each condition is read from the tables is in the script's docstring. Sixteen planted faults, CL-2's two among them and one for each other condition, each run through the same derivation on a corrupted copy, must each move their entry to the case named, or nothing is written.
name: channelscope.cl3.gate_cases

parameters.cl2_usability_from: curation/cl2_run_e888359/cl2_numbering_entries.tsv at c4e8b66: '# Run: complete' and '# Outcomes: usable'
parameters.code_digest_form: SHA-256 over this script and the channelscope package's source files, each as its path from how/runtime/channelscope, a NUL, its bytes with CRLF as LF, a NUL, in path order
parameters.planted_faults: CL-2's first: one gate's outcome set to 'disputed' (9NMO): caught (9NMO: c (chain A: gate outcome 'disputed')); CL-2's second: a (b) entry's anchoring run cut to 5 residues (6W1N): caught (6W1N: c (chain B: its run of offset 0 holds 2 modelled residues before the gate and 2 after it)); a (b) chain whose path S is mapped (6W1N): caught (6W1N: c (chain B: path A only in a chain SIFTS maps (path S 'mapped'))); an (a) chain's gate residue not an isoleucine (9NMO): caught (9NMO: c (chain A: the residue is VAL, not an isoleucine)); an (a) chain's gate one position off (9NMO): caught (9NMO: c (chain A: species position 4936, not the author number 4935)); an (a) chain's run identity low (9NMO): caught (9NMO: c (chain A: its run is identity low)); a (b) chain's run off by one (6W1N): caught (6W1N: c (chain B: its run's offset is 1)); an (a) chain's gate note not '-' (9NMO): caught (9NMO: c (chain A: gate note 'departs by 1')); a (b) chain's run a short departing run (6W1N): caught (6W1N: c (chain B: its run is a short departing run on path A alone)); a (b) chain's run of another status than its gate (6W1N): caught (6W1N: c (chain B: its run's status 'agree' is not the gate's outcome 'path A only')); a (b) chain's run whose count does not match its span (6W1N): caught (6W1N: c (chain B: its run's modelled residues cannot be counted on each side)); a (b) chain whose gate and its run are of another category at offset 0 (6W1N): caught (6W1N: c (chain B: gate outcome 'UNK')); a (b) chain with two runs holding its gate (6W1N): caught (6W1N: c (chain B: 2 runs hold author number 4935)); a chain whose gate residue is not S13's (9NMO): caught (9NMO: c (chain A: CL-2 read 'I4936', S13 measured 'I4935')); an entry with no analysed chain (9NMO): caught (9NMO: d (no analysed RyR1 chain)); CL-2's run not usable (9NMO): caught (9NMO: d (CL-2's run is not usable))

description: CL-4: the composition over a residue set fixed in advance, by the criteria what/context/context_channelscope_cl4_composition_criteria_v3.md (version 3, with Q1 to Q3 answered (c), (c), (c)): L1 partners, L2 structures by L2's rule on CL-2's tables with CL-3's classes and gate cases, L3 gnomAD, L4 ClinVar; checks and planted faults as the criteria's table fixes them. The run's end is taken before its records are assembled; C4 and C4-P then run on the assembled records.
name: channelscope.cl4.compose
